aliases: Pekin I Developer LLC Data Center
developer: Western Hospitality Partners / Pekin I Developer LLC
status_detail: City of Pekin issued development-standard requirements in Jan. 2026 for a proposed data center at 3528 Edgewater Drive; local reporting says Mayor Mary Burress announced on Mar. 9, 2026 that Pekin would not move forward, and WHP later terminated the purchase agreement in May 2026.
notes: Official Pekin PDF names Pekin I Developer LLC, Proposed Data Center Facility, 3528 Edgewater Drive, and parcel IDs. WCBU reports the project would have used about one-third of the 1,000-acre Lutticken Farm property; Cleanview marks the 320-acre Tazewell project canceled.
